review_story.summary: SOS bracelet story in five text cards: dad fell and lay in the bathroom for 5 hours, son at work had no idea, so he bought the bracelet; press the button, instant alert; hug.
review_story.hook: 'My dad fell and was left alone in the bathroom for 5 hours ❤️😢' over an old man lying on a bathroom floor.
highlights: 0–5s: emotional story opening, one sentence, old man on the floor, close-up of a lost clog
5–8.8s: two more cards: son at the office (US flag on desk), then 'So I got him this' with the SENVIA box
9.5s: the SOS button press with a click SFX, phone lights up, son looks at the phone
13.4s: 'Comment HELP if you want one' over father and son hugging — CTA on the emotional peak
